name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-raccoon-wario
title: Super Mario World Styled Raccoon Wario
description:
For those who want to give Wario the raccoon powers but cannot due to the lack of graphics, here it is, I simply used Raccoon Mario graphics and mixed them with Wario's graphics, exept with the raccoon ears, because I drew those myself.

in order to us it, you'll need Neosz's Raccoon patch.

Credit to SuperLuigiBros, because I won't have done it without the Wario bros graphics.

UPDATE 23/04/2020: added a missing raccoon ear to to wario when he faces straight.
